{{nihongo|'''Kumaku Shrine'''|久麻久神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Nishio|ar|نيشيو (آيتشي)|azb|نیشیو، آیچی|ce|Нисио|ceb|Nishio (lungsod sa Hapon)|ckb|نیشیۆ|cs|Nišio|de|Nishio|eo|Niŝio|es|Nishio|fa|نیشیو، آیچی|fi|Nishio|fj|Nishio|fr|Nishio|gl|Nishio|hy|Նիսիո|id|Nishio, Aichi|it|Nishio|ja|西尾市|kk|Нисио|ko|니시오시|lij|Nishio|mg|Nishio|ms|Nishio, Aichi|mzn|نیشیو، آیچی|nl|Nishio|no|Nishio|pl|Nishio|pnb|نیشو|pt|Nishio|ro|Nishio|ru|Нисио|sh|Nishio|sr|Нишио|sv|Nishio (stad)|tg|Нишио|th|นิชิโอะ|tl|Nishio|tr|Nishio|tt|Нисио|uk|Нісіо|ur|نیشیو، ایچی|uz|Nishio|vi|Nishio, Aichi|war|Nishio, Aichi|zh|西尾市|zh_classical|西尾市|zh_min_nan|Nisio-chhī|zh_yue|西尾|qid=Q317844}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|Q80434|qid=Q80434}}. Its former shrine rank was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}. {{nihongo|'''Kumaku Shrine'''|久麻久神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mikawa Province]].

== Overview ==
Its precincts are in {{ill|Yatsuomote-chō|ja|八ツ面町|qid=Q87701383}} Urai and {{ill|Kumami-chō|ja|熊味町|qid=Q80930815}}. The main hall in Yatsumote-ch? is a one-bay irimoya-zukuri structure with a three-bay front porch, built in {{ill|1527|Q6412|qid=Q6412}} (Daiei 7), and is a {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Q1188622|qid=Q1188622|lt=national Important Cultural Property}}. It is an {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki-listed shrine}}. The enshrined deities are {{ill|Emperor Nintoku|Q313119|qid=Q313119|lt=?sazaki-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}}, and {{ill|Atsuta Shrine|Q482065|qid=Q482065|lt=Atsuta-no-?kami}}. It is said to have been founded in the era of Emperor Sujin.
